tide.feature: Add an export for tide alerts so harbour masters can get them out of the app.

controls.title: CSV download
controls.mechanism: A button writes the current alerts to a CSV file the harbour master saves from the app.

controls.title: Email digest
controls.mechanism: The app emails the day's alerts as a plain list to an address the harbour master sets once.

controls.title: Radio-ready script
controls.mechanism: The app renders each alert as a short spoken-style line, in the order a harbour master would read it out on the VHF channel, and offers it as a printable card or a text-to-speech clip.

controls.title: Berth-board overlay
controls.mechanism: The app exports each alert as a time-stamped strip keyed to berth numbers, so the harbour office can lay it over its own wall chart or tide table without retyping.

shopping.feature: Let people share their shopping lists with family.

controls.title: Share by link
controls.mechanism: A button creates a link to the list that family members open to see and tick items.

controls.title: Invite by email
controls.mechanism: The owner enters family email addresses and each person gets an invitation to join the list.

controls.title: Aisle-split claiming
controls.mechanism: Sharing splits the list by store section, and each family member who is in the shop claims a section, so nobody buys the same item twice.

controls.title: Household standing list
controls.mechanism: The family shares one always-open household list; any member who finishes an item at the till clears it for everyone, and the list learns which items recur each week.

notes.feature: Add a way to export a note to PDF.

controls.title: Print to PDF
controls.mechanism: An export button renders the note body with the page's print style and saves it as a PDF.

controls.title: Server-side render
controls.mechanism: The note is sent to a service that converts it to a PDF and returns the file for download.

controls.title: Shareable page set
controls.mechanism: The export lays the note out as a booklet with a cover, a contents page built from its headings, and page breaks chosen at heading boundaries, ready to print and fold.

controls.title: Living PDF
controls.mechanism: The exported PDF embeds the note's source and a version stamp, so opening it in the app again restores the editable note and shows what changed since the export.
